description: Grade 5 optional enrichment example: rewrite one bar from 6/8 to 2/4.

provenance.authoredBy: Music Theory Path curriculum team (Brief 10 addendum)

item.prompt: Rewrite this bar of 6/8 in 2/4 so every note and rest keeps the same share of its beat. Beam by the new beats.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 6/8 (two dotted-crotchet beats), unpitched rhythm on a single line.

hints: 6/8 has two dotted-crotchet beats; 2/4 has two crotchet beats. Match each beat to its partner.

feedback.correct: Correct. Going from compound to simple time, the dotted-crotchet beat becomes a crotchet beat, so each dot is removed: two dotted quavers become two quavers, and the dotted crotchet becomes a crotchet.

mistakes.values-copied-unchanged: Copying the values leaves a bar of the wrong length for 2/4. Compare one beat in each time signature first.
mistakes.rest-not-rewritten: A rest fills the same share of the beat as a note, so it changes in exactly the same way.
mistakes.dots-kept-in-simple-time: A simple beat is undotted, so the dots must come off when going from compound to simple time.
mistakes.beam-across-beats: Start a new beam on each new beat so the beats stay visible.

feedback.fallback: Going from compound to simple time, the dotted-crotchet beat becomes a crotchet beat, so each dot is removed: two dotted quavers become two quavers, and the dotted crotchet becomes a crotchet.
